transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the transaction (e.g. tx_1001)

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the cardholder/account (e.g. usr_4012)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when transaction occurred

velocity_6h.description: Number of transactions attempted by user in past 6 hours

zip_count_4w.description: Number of distinct ZIP codes used in past 4 weeks

merchant_category.description: Category of merchant (e.g. electronics, grocery, crypto_exchange)

geo_distance_km.description: Distance in kilometers from user's primary residence

device_os.description: Operating system of the initiating device (android, ios, windows, mac, linux)

fraud_bool.description: Ground truth indicator from BAF dataset (0 = Legitimate, 1 = Fraudulent)
